description: A user-defined HTML tag (`customElements.define('cart-summary', Class)`) with lifecycle callbacks; a framework-neutral integration contract.
Static list of attribute names whose changes trigger `attributeChangedCallback`.
Called when the element enters or leaves the document; the natural place to create and unmount a React root.
An event carrying `detail`; `bubbles` lets ancestors listen and `composed` lets it cross Shadow DOM boundaries.
An encapsulated DOM subtree with isolated styles; strong isolation at the cost of theming, form and ARIA relations across the boundary.
Props become properties when the element defines them, otherwise attributes; `on<event>` props add listeners for custom events.
